AthsEn: Bárðardalsvegur Vestri (Road 842) will be closed from September 12th to December 1st, from Ring Road 1 to Bárðardalsvegur Eystri (Road 844) by the bridge over Skjálfandafljót. Traffic to Sprengisandsleið is detoured via Bárðardalsvegur Eystri (Road 844) at Fosshóll
